text:
suyog: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we tighten the decision-graph contract so the runtime can ask for 'strict' vs 'best_effort' scoring and attach a telemetry token for sim/ops correlation.
jessica: Can you sketch the API shape? example payload?
suyog: idea: { decision_id, objective: "latency|cost|geo", mode: "strict|best_effort", telemetry_context: "string" }
ben: +1 for telemetry_context, ops needs a stable id we can map to traces.
rahul: how does this affect fallback semantics? strict vs best_effort sounds like it changes preemption behavior.
suyog: strict -> prevent additional fallbacks unless route is explicitly degradable. best_effort -> allow fallback on latency/capacity signals.
sam: ops Q: will telemetry_context be multi-tenant safe? any PII risk?
jessica: must be opaque token, TTL-limited, no PII. KMS sign; runtime verifies signature.
ops-bot: deploy-plan reminder: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (approval required)
ben: sim needs stable mapping between decision_id and sim_case. reserve a 128-bit UUID namespace for decision_id.
rahul: add decision_hints: { cost_budget_micros, latency_sla_ms } so policy can express soft constraints.
suyog: agreed. contract = decision_id, mode, objective, telemetry_context?, decision_hints?
jessica: wire-level: protobuf v2, runtime should ignore unknown fields, require header x-policy-version.
sam: sec: telemetry_context signed with customer key for private; hosted uses redwood-signed index token.
ben: perf: telemetry_context increases request size. make it optional and keep token small (~32 bytes).
rahul: compress with base62 token to shrink footprint.
suyog: ops: need pipeline to join traces -> decision events -> sim runs. ben/ops to propose join keys by EOD.
jessica: compat plan: runtime accepts legacy payloads; default mode=best_effort for old clients.
ben: rollout plan: proto change -> runtime guard -> sim harness update. estimate 2 weeks if no blockers.
sam: add telemetry-metrics tag so Console can filter traces by decision_id.
ops-bot: @ops-team please add runbook entry for anomalous decision spike detection.
ben: I'll open schema PR + sim harness tweak. @jessica will draft runtime validation & fallback logic.
suyog: action items recap: ben -> schema PR, jessica -> runtime guard + fallback change, ops -> trace join keys & runbook, rahul -> update fallbacks doc. check-in Fri.
jessica: nit: document TTL for telemetry tokens + revocation semantics.
suyog: good call, I'll add to the RFC.
sam: :thumbsup:
ben: thanks all, starting PRs now.
ops-bot: scheduled canary window at 2026-03-25T15:00Z
